artifacts.text_content:
Claimpower EMR version 6.1 CCDA Export


•   Export CCDA for single patient
    https://www.claimpowerehr.com/curesUpdate/CCDA_Export_Signle_Patient.PDF

•   Export CCDA for Multiple Patients
    https://www.claimpowerehr.com/curesUpdate/CCDA_Multiple_Patients.PDF



•   Export/download CCDA from patient portal
    https://www.claimpowerehr.com/curesUpdate/CCDA_Patient_Portal.PDF
 Export CCDA for single patient:-

Visit the claimpower website:- https://www.claimpowerehr.com/ and login with User ID and password.



Step 1 → Click on Lookup Medical Records.




Step 2 → Search for the patient name and select it.
 Step 3 → Click on Clinical Document Icon which is located on the right side.




Step 4 → Click on Summary of Care Records.




Step 5 → CCDA will be automatically selected and click on generate.
 Step 6 → Click on Zip icon to download.




Step 7 → The window will pop- up with the option of download and we can share the zip file.
 Export CCDA for Multiple Patients:-

Visit the claimpower website:- https://www.claimpowerehr.com/ and login with User ID and password.



Step 1 → Click on EMR Reports.




Step 2 → Click on Export Patient Medical Records.




Step 3 → Search for specific patients or check mark the box for all patient’s.
 Step 4 → Select multiple patient’s and generate the Zip File.




------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Export/download CCDA from patient portal:-

Visit the claimpower website:- https://www.claimpowerehr.com/

Step 1 → Click on the Patient Portal




Step 2 → Enter the patient details and the submit it.




Step 3 → Click on View health Information to generate complete information from the beginning.
 Step 4 → Click on Summary of care records icon
 Step 5 → Click on Zip file to download it.
